finding.text: The wire work is not committed, but the brief says "Commit by exact path". `git status` in the worktree shows core/Page/page.js, core/Page/readme.md, card/page.js, card/mini-pages/MiniPages.js, card/inventory.json and card/doc/inventory.md all still modified. Because of that, review/diff.patch shows the older branch commits, not this change: it still has the old Concepts-tile card/page.js, so the patch cannot be used to review this work.

Brief items 1–3 are done in the working tree. `card` sits in core/Page/page.js:66 after `weight`, the readme line is word for word at core/Page/readme.md:21, and card/page.js:47–55 goes live sample → preview wall → a two-sentence paragraph. Every sample class exists in card.css (lines 21–69), so nothing new was added.
card/page.js:26 (and headers/page.js:29,42): the ⋯ menu is `<a href="#">`. It opens nothing, and a click adds `#` to the url. A `<button>`, or a link to the headers/ page, would be honest.

MiniPages.js:55 has a sensible local fix for the `card` method hiding Page's `card` class string. The collision itself is a trap for any other page.jsonl verb named after a Page property, so worth a line in the page skill's improvements.md, or renaming the verb (e.g. `mini`) instead of patching preview().

Page-card/sheet.png: the order is right, and at 1920 the four grounds fill one row with the six previews below. At 1280 "Strong hue" wraps alone onto a second row, so a `--column` near 16em would keep all four in one row. At 3440 the sample cards stretch very wide while the previews stop at about two thirds of the width (72% empty).

The preview tiles in Page-card/sheet.png are text-only, and their descriptions are cut off after about two lines. A reader can find all six, but nothing shows what each one looks like. A small picture per tile would fit "show, don't tell" better.

Page-card-mini-pages/sheet.png (not in this fence, from an earlier commit): the dark "Going deep" card's text is almost invisible, dark on dark, at all three widths. The `a.card.card-dark` probably picks up the link or text color instead of the dark island's.
In Page-card/sheet.png, the Default sample's nested level-2 card is the same gray as the Light gray ground beside it. So in the row, the first two samples read as nearly the same thing.

answer.reply: fixed: committed (fdb587f1) — the work was real, just not committed yet when the reviewer ran; every named file is now in that commit.

fixed: the ⋯ button is now a real <button class="card-menu-btn"> (no href, no #). headers/page.js's own demo still uses a.href('#') for the same shape, but that file is outside this task's fence — left alone.

fixed: appended a line to .claude/skills/page/improvements.md naming the exact trap (a page.jsonl verb shadowing a Page property) and the properties list to check against. Renaming MiniPages' own `card` verb is mastermind-page's call, not mine to make on a file outside this task's three named edits.

fixed the 1280 wrap: sample grid --column dropped from 18em to 16em, all four now fit one row at 1280. Declined the 3440 preview-wall width: this.previews()'s --column is the same knob every other index page on the site uses (core/page.js, overview/wall, etc.) at the same rough size — widening it further here would be a site-wide convention change, not a wiring fix.

declined for this task: a thumbnail needs each of the five child pages (grounds, nesting, headers, scale, log) to override preview() with its own live render (the `preview(nav){ return this.preview_card(nav, () => ...); }` pattern in Page.class.js) — five separate design decisions, not a wiring change. Left as a clean follow-up; this.previews()'s default text+icon card is exactly what most index pages on the site already show.

declined: confirmed pre-existing, predates this task (card/mini-pages/page.jsonl's own earlier commit) and is outside this task's three named files. Real bug, worth its own fix — noted here so it doesn't get lost: card/mini-pages/page.jsonl's 'going-deep' (card-dark ground) needs its .card-dark island's own ink color, not the page's.

declined: this is card.css's own by-design rule (grounds/page.js's own demo shows the same thing on purpose) — a plain .card nested inside a plain .card switches to var(--wash), the exact same token the Light gray ground itself uses, so the two DO read alike when placed side by side. That is the documented nesting rule (card.css:24-32), not a bug this wiring task introduced or should redesign.

reply.text: Adding thumbnails needs each of the five child pages to write its own `preview()` override, which is five separate design decisions, not a wiring fix; leaving the default text+icon card (which matches most index pages on the site) and filing the rest as a follow-up is reasonable.

This is a real bug, but it predates this task and lives outside the three named files; declining it here and writing down exactly what needs fixing (card-dark's own ink color) so it isn't lost is the right call.

The matching gray is card.css's documented nesting rule, not something this task introduced — a nested plain card and a Light gray ground both resolve to `--wash` on purpose, so this isn't a bug to fix here.

answer.reply: noted: confirms items 1-3 are done, no action needed.
